## Technology Stack
- Markup: Semantic HTML5 with complete bilingual support: Arabic (index.html, dir="rtl", lang="ar") and English (en.html, dir="ltr", lang="en")
- Image Pipeline: High-performance Next-Gen WebP optimization with responsive picture tags and preloading
- Styling: Custom Pure CSS3 Architecture (Logical properties, responsive flex/grid, zero external frameworks)
- Logic: Vanilla ECMAScript (ES2022+), zero external runtime dependencies
- Typography: Google Fonts (Cairo & Tajawal)
- Performance Profile: Core Web Vitals optimized, sub-second LCP on mobile, lightweight WebP assets
